runtimes.value: mlx-video (TI2V-5B, converted from the original non-Diffusers checkpoint); ComfyUI native (silent frame corruption on MPS: #15010, #15793, #16644 open; uni_pc runs float32 on MPS, use euler, #16573); Draw Things (Wan 2.2 5B since Oct 2025, import of 5B models and LoRAs); stable-diffusion.cpp (Metal, Comfy-Org or GGUF); diffusers WanPipeline (Diffusers repo; text encoder lost embed_tokens under transformers 5.0-5.2, pin 4.57.1 or use a release with transformers PR #43880, merged 19.02.2026); DiffSynth-Studio (says replace 'cuda' with 'mps'). Official Wan2.2 code has no MPS support (feature request #336 open)
runtimes.note: mlx-video's converter reads the original Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B repo with .pth T5 and VAE files (torch.load weights_only=True), not the Diffusers repo; community pre-converted MLX repos exist (e.g. SceneWorks/wan2.2-ti2v-5b-mlx), not checked. The Wan 2.2 VAE (z=48) encode is corrupted on MPS with PyTorch < 2.15 above 2^20 pixels (ComfyUI#16433, reported for Qwen-Image 2.1, same AvgDown3D layer); impact on TI2V image conditioning unverified. Which transformers release first includes PR #43880 is unverified (likely 5.3.0).

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, issues of mflux, ComfyUI, mlx-video and ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper. **Reddit could not be read**; blogs and developers promoting their own engines are leads only. Released 28.07.2025; window: 13.05–13.11.2026. Feedback thin except for Mac bugs.
web.summary: Aging; test on the Mac with the euler sampler before relying on it.
web.verdict: Aging, LTX 2.3 preferred; silent frame corruption on Macs in ComfyUI, use euler

comments.text: **Mac**: in ComfyUI on MPS, frames degrade (banding, over-saturation) after the first one, silently; seen on M3 Pro, M4 Pro, M4 Max and base M5 ([ComfyUI#15010, 20.07.2026](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues/15010); [#15793, 21.08.2026](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues/15793); [#16644, 29.09.2026](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues/16644)). One cause: the `uni_pc` sampler; `euler` works ([#16573, 26.09.2026](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues/16573)).
Still used, but LTX 2.3 is now the usual fast local choice ([vunderba, 15.05.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48155014)).
